text:
maria: quick heads-up — did a hybrid AWQ->GPTQ bake on new-1.3B bring-up. accuracy regression concentrated in a handful of channels in layers 7 / 11 / 23. uploading short logs and a quick mitigation I prototyped.
jordan: can you drop the per-layer histograms + a minimal repro (cmd + sample inputs)?
maria: sure. command i ran:
```
run_quant_bake --model new-1.3b --modes awq,gptq --eval lm-eval --out /tmp/qb_19123.log --seed 42
```
sample log excerpts: 
```
L7 chan 142 z=8.9 kurt=24.3
L7 chan 143 z=0.9 kurt=1.2
L11 chan 5  z=7.1 kurt=19.5
L23 chan 88 z=9.4 kurt=30.1
```
these three channels explain most of the token-wise KL spikes in the validation runs.
lee: looks like spikes are in the FFN dense1 outputs, not attention. small surgical fixes make sense: detect top-k outlier channels per-layer, zero or clamp them and apply per-channel rescale to preserve downstream distribution. less invasive than layer-skip.
ev an: +1 to surgical approach. also add a skip-layer fallback when surgical pruning still regresses more than threshold. quick helper to emit skiplist from the log:
```
python tools/find_outliers.py --log /tmp/qb_19123.log --zthresh 6.5 --topk 3 --emit-skiplist > skiplist.json
```
jordan: curious about numbers — what was the perplexity delta and throughput change?
maria: baseline fp16 ppl=12.6, awq-only ppl=13.7, hybrid (awq with targeted gptq fallback on skipped layers) ppl=12.2 on the same eval split. throughput down ~8% due to fallback nodes; cost per token + ~3% but accuracy delta is acceptable for this customer profile.
lee: good. another benign option is per-channel clamp to 3 sigma instead of zeroing — preserves more capacity but less accuracy gain.
ev an: scheduling a 24h bakeoff with bootstrapped eval sets and ablation (zero vs clamp vs rescale). will need dedicated GPUs. pinging @ops for pool.
maria: opened a quick config PR (WIP): `{"surgical_prune":true,"per_channel_rescale":true,"skip_layers":[7,11,23],"fallback_policy":"gptq-compat","z_threshold":6.5}`
deploy-bot: deployment canary started: pool=dp-43, job=canary-1912345678, triggered_at=1912345777 by maria :rocket:
lee: note for the RFC — include per-channel kurtosis plots and a before/after token-level KL heatmap, plus the throughput/cost tradeoff.
jordan: +1, also add a small script to revert skiplist at runtime (hot toggle) in case of regression.
maria: will write up a short RFC under docs/quant/hybrid-surgical-1912345678 and attach graphs: https://internal/redwood/graphs/qb/1912345678
ev an: thanks — i'll post bakeoff schedule and results here once done. :white_check_mark:
